doc.title: Tony Parenti and Anthony Sbarbaro Interview, 1959-06-29

title: Bill Gallaty, the Brunies brothers and the Tango Palace
summary: Recalling Bill Gallaty's band, Jack Laine's hires, the Brunies family, and working at the Tango Palace for 10.50 a week, with remarks on white New Orleans jazz.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope
